entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: Relic hunter from Ondu who found the Seer's Sundial.

entities.name: Ghazzan
entities.description: Minotaur on Javad's team who protected the group and was killed by a monstrous creature.

entities.name: Keeda
entities.description: Goblin trapfinder who died saving the group from vipers and a basilisk.

entities.name: Seer's Sundial
entities.description: Ancient, massive stone device whose inscriptions portend a dark future.

entities.name: Serpentcutter
entities.description: Ship the team bartered aboard to cross the Silundi Sea.

entities.name: Crypt of Agadeem
entities.description: Source of a monstrous creature that killed Ghazzan.

entities.name: Graypelt Refuge
entities.description: Refuge where Javad decides to unburden himself.

events.summary: Javad's team sets out with a hurda packbeast; they lose the hurda and kill a felidar.
events.quote: managing to kill the felidar with Ghazzan's and Javad's combined efforts

events.summary: Ghazzan protects the group in the marshlands but falls prey to a monstrous creature from the Crypt of Agadeem.
events.quote: Ghazzan bravely protected the group but ultimately fell prey to a monstrous creature

events.summary: The team crosses the Silundi Sea aboard the Serpentcutter.
events.quote: The team bartered their way aboard the Serpentcutter

events.summary: Keeda dies in Turntimber saving the group from vipers and a basilisk.
events.quote: where Keeda died saving the group from a pit of vipers and a basilisk

events.summary: On the solstice Javad and Sali Oran discover the Seer's Sundial and read its dark inscriptions.
events.quote: Javad and Sali Oran discovered the Seer's Sundial

events.summary: Dreading its revelations, Javad decides to seek refuge at Graypelt Refuge.
events.quote: he decided to seek refuge and unburden himself at Graypelt Refuge

relations.quote: is a relic hunter from Ondu
